name: 國立金門大學 圓樓中央入口立面段
title: 圓樓・正面中央入口立面段（照片近似；非完整建築）

repository_check.method: Existing exact-revision tree names and archived school/inventory metadata; no clone

scope: Central entrance facade only; not whole roundhouse. Artificial neutral rear/side cuts and display base.
units: model millimetres; no measured architectural scale
construction: Authored Boolean solid union; sub-0.0001 mm quantization slivers welded before STL export; no source pixels or third-party mesh
render_coordinate_system: Local -Y entrance, +Y artificial rear cut; not compass directions
uncertainties: Photo capture dates unknown; document date not capture date; not a verified 2026-current survey
No measured width, radius, opening depth, column diameter, roof slope or scale
Brick bond, tile rhythm, rail spacing and mullion counts are authored simplifications
Rear closure, side cuts and base are artificial support, not as-built geometry
DWG obtained but not interpreted; point-cloud roof gaps do not establish roof openings
omitted: Full circular building and complete roof
Changing retail signs, landscaping, people and vehicles

printing.notes: Check 1 mm rails/mullions, wide lintel, inset windows and front eave in the selected slicer. 726 horizontal sections are a geometric screen only.

readme_images: Six actual model views embedded in two three-column Markdown image tables
